cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Tala was warm, apologetic and respectful, and she handled the caller's doubt about the outage start time honestly and calmly. Her Taglish was mostly English-led with set Tagalog phrases like 'Sandali lang po' and 'Walang anuman po'. The closing line leaned a bit more Tagalog than the style prefers, and her last reply to the outage question ran a little long.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang araw. Kanina pa pong umaga walang internet dito sa bahay namin sa Batasan Hills. Gusto ko lang po sanang malaman kung bakit at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Magandang araw po, and I'm sorry to hear there's no internet since this morning. Before I check, may I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on the account, po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, account number ko po ay 8012345601. Yung last four digits ng mobile number na naka-register ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Sandali lang po, let me check.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Maria, there's an outage in Batasan Hills. A fiber cable was cut along Batasan Road during road works, starting around 3:43 PM. Service is expected back around 10:13 PM tonight.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ay, salamat po sa info. Pero ang alam ko po, kaninang umaga pa nawala yung internet namin, hindi pa 3:43 PM. Same outage pa rin po ba yun?

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo, I understand. The system only shows this one outage in your area, and it started at 3:43 PM, so I can't confirm if it's the same problem you've had since morning. If you still have no internet after 10:13 PM tonight, please call us back so we can look into it further po.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sige po, naiintindihan ko. Salamat po sa paliwanag at sa oras na binigay ninyo. Tatawag na lang po ulit ako kung wala pa rin pagdating ng 10:13 PM. Maraming salamat po, paalam na po!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Walang anuman po, Maria. Salamat po sa pagtawag sa Kidlat Fiber, ingat po!
